title: Round half cents up without touching vendored code
carries: Never edit anything under legacy/ (vendored, overwritten on next sync); fix on our side.
pricing.total(items, tax_rate) keeps its exact signature.
why_not_in_repo: The rules were stated by the user in session 1 only. Nothing in the repository marks legacy/ as read-only, and the buggy rounding lives in legacy/money.py, so the shortest fix is to edit it.

learn: User rule: never edit anything under legacy/ because it is vendored from the payments team and overwritten on the next sync. Fix problems on our side instead.
User rule: keep the signature of pricing.total(items, tax_rate) exactly as it is because other services call it.
stub.recall_query: rules for legacy directory and pricing total signature
